list.name: asset_class
list.label: Asset class
list.query: Cash : cash, Odd lot : odd_lot, Forward (termo) : forward, Futures : future, Futures spreads : spread, Options (stocks, ETFs, indexes) : option, Options on futures : future_option, Other : other

list.name: ticker
list.label: Ticker
list.query:
WITH pr AS (
  SELECT *,
    CASE
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{3}[FGHJKMNQUVXZ][0-9]{2}$')
        AND (open_interest IS NOT NULL OR min_trade_limit IS NOT NULL OR adjusted_quote_status IS NOT NULL) THEN 'future'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[0-9]{1,2}$') THEN 'cash'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[0-9]{1,2}F$') THEN 'odd_lot'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[0-9]{1,2}T$') THEN 'forward'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '[FGHJKMNQUVXZ][0-9]{2}[FGHJKMNQUVXZ][0-9]{2}$') THEN 'spread'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '[FGHJKMNQUVXZ][0-9]{2}[CP][0-9]+E?$') THEN 'future_option'
      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[A-X][0-9]+') THEN 'option'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS asset_class
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
)
SELECT ticker
FROM pr
WHERE asset_class IN ($asset_class)
  AND trades > 0
GROUP BY ticker
ORDER BY sum(volume_brl) DESC
LIMIT 1000

  WHERE $__timeFilter(trad_dt::TIMESTAMP)
),
daily AS (
  SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, ticker, arg_max(last_price, volume_brl)::DOUBLE AS close
  FROM pr
  WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
    AND asset_class IN ($asset_class)
    AND last_price IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ALL
),
r AS (
  SELECT ticker, arg_max(close, time) / nullif(arg_min(close, time), 0) - 1 AS period_return
  FROM daily
  GROUP BY ticker
)
SELECT avg(period_return) AS avg_return
FROM r

panels.title: Daily change

WITH pr AS (

        AND (open_interest IS NOT NULL OR min_trade_limit IS NOT NULL OR adjusted_quote_status IS NOT NULL) THEN 'future'

      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[0-9]{1,2}T$') THEN 'forward'

      WHEN regexp_matches(ticker, '^[A-Z0-9]{4}[A-X][0-9]+') THEN 'option'
      ELSE 'other'
    END AS asset_class
  FROM read_parquet('s3://uploads/b3_bulletin_price_report/daily_parse/*.parquet')
  WHERE trad_dt::TIMESTAMP >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMP - INTERVAL 10 DAY
    AND trad_dt::TIMESTAMP <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMP
),
daily AS (
  SELECT trad_dt::TIMESTAMP AS time, ticker, arg_max(last_price, volume_brl)::DOUBLE AS close
  FROM pr
  WHERE ticker IN ($ticker)
    AND asset_class IN ($asset_class)
    AND last_price IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY ALL
),
changes AS (
  SELECT time, ticker, close / nullif(lag(close) OVER (PARTITION BY ticker ORDER BY time), 0) - 1 AS change
  FROM daily
)
SELECT time, ticker, change
FROM changes
WHERE $__timeFilter(time)
  AND change IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY time, ticker

panels.title: Daily range (high vs low)
